name: Google AI Studio
free_plan_limits: Limited access to some models; Gemini 3.8 Flash, 3.5 Flash-Lite and Gemma 4 free of charge
usage_note: Per 1M tokens, e.g. Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite $0.30 in / $2.50 out; images from about $0.034 each
since_note: Renamed from MakerSuite; Gemini API opened December 13, 2023 (Wikipedia).
best_for: Gemini models and cheap image generation
notes: Free-tier content may be used to improve Google products. No monthly fee, so a monthly business cost can't be stated. OpenAI compatibility: not stated on the pricing page.

name: OpenRouter
free_plan_limits: 25+ free models, 20 requests a minute and 50 a day (1,000 a day after $10 of credits)
usage_note: 5.5% fee when you buy credits; model use billed at the provider's list price
notes: 600+ models from 80+ providers on paid plans. Fee is on credit purchases, not per request. Image support not stated on the pricing page.

name: OpenAI API
usage_note: Per 1M tokens, e.g. gpt-6-luna $0.10 in / $0.50 out; gpt-image-2 $30 per 1M image output tokens
since_note: Announced June 11, 2020 as a private beta (OpenAI).
notes: Pricing page shows no general free tier for text models (free tier: not stated). Batch is about half price. No monthly fee.

name: Ollama
free_plan_limits: Running models on your own computer is unlimited; cloud models pay per token
usage_note: Cloud models per 1M tokens, e.g. gpt-oss:20b $0.07 in / $0.30 out
best_for: Running open models on your own PC
notes: Pro is $20/mo with $60 of monthly cloud credits; Max is $100. Local use needs no plan. Open-source status is from public repo, not the pricing page. OpenAI compatibility not stated on the pricing page.

name: Anthropic API
usage_note: Per 1M tokens in/out: Haiku 5.5 $0.10/$0.50, Sonnet 5.5 $2/$10, Opus 5.5 $4/$20
since_note: API opened for early access March 14, 2023 (secondary wiki).
best_for: Claude models for text and code
notes: Batch saves 50%. The free Claude app plan is not an API free tier; API free tier not stated. Reads images but does not generate them.

name: fal.ai
usage_note: Per output, e.g. FLUX.1 schnell $0.003/megapixel, Kling Video v3 Pro $0.14/second
best_for: Image and video models by the output
notes: About 117 image, video, audio and 3D endpoints shown. Free credits and OpenAI compatibility: not stated. GPUs billed per hour too.

name: Hugging Face
free_plan_limits: Free CPU Basic Space (2 vCPU, 16 GB RAM) and free ZeroGPU access
notes: PRO is $9/mo with $2 of inference credits. Team is $20 per user. Inference, storage and GPU Spaces are billed extra (T4 about $0.40/hour).

name: Replicate
usage_note: Per run, e.g. flux-dev $0.025 per image, flux-1.1-pro $0.04 per image; GPUs from $0.81/hour (T4)
best_for: Pay per run for image and video models
notes: Private models bill for idle time too. Free credits and OpenAI compatibility: not stated on the pricing page.

name: Kie.ai
usage_note: 1 credit is about $0.005; gpt image 2 from $0.03 per image, kling 4.0 flash from $0.0565 per second
notes: No subscription; credits never expire and failed tasks aren't charged. Free credits not mentioned. OpenAI compatibility not stated.

name: Together AI
usage_note: Per 1M tokens, e.g. gpt-oss-120B $0.15 in / $0.60 out; FLUX.2 [dev] $0.0154 per image
notes: Page says 'Start for free' but gives no credit amount. Dedicated H100 is $5.49/hour. OpenAI compatibility not stated on the pricing page.

name: LM Studio
since_note: First public release May 2023 (aiwiki; company quote).
best_for: Running local models in a desktop app
notes: Not stated: the home page shows no price. It says you can download local models in the app. OpenAI-compatible server and open-source status not stated there.
